done_when: After a retest, when the default branch moved again, merge checks the new commits against the item's changed files again and merges at once when none overlap; with an overlap it retests again; it stops only after five moves, and a test covers two moves in a row
why: On a busy day forge merge keeps stopping with 'The default branch moved again': after one retest it gives up when main moves during the retest, so items race each other and none merge (four in a row today, the sign-off hotfix among them)
